item.description: Purchased item data, including identity, price, and sale basis.

original.description: Quantity from the original checkout, expressed as an integer step count.

total.description: Current active quantity after returns, cancellations, or other order changes, expressed as an integer step count.

fulfilled.description: Quantity fulfilled so far, expressed as an integer step count.

quantity.description: Tracks the line item's original, current active, and fulfilled quantities. All three values use the same inherited `item.quantity_unit`. When `item.quantity_unit` is absent on an authoritative order response, each step is one whole item (`each`) under the shared default.

status.description: Derived status: removed if quantity.total == 0, fulfilled if quantity.total > 0 and quantity.fulfilled == quantity.total, partial if quantity.total > 0 and quantity.fulfilled > 0, otherwise processing.

parent_id.description: Parent line item identifier for any nested structures.
